results.evidence: Governed SLO breaches set issueRequired and the negative fixture rejects a breach without an issue link. The scheduled workflow creates or comments on an exact-title GitHub issue; it never deploys or merges.

Every machine breach threshold is referenced through thresholds.* config keys; literal/hard-coded threshold-source fixtures fail closed. Discovery lag remains observational because the mandate defines no breach threshold.

Current baseline has no freeze proposal. Repeated breaches use thresholds.deployFreezeConsecutiveBreaches and unresolved proposal escalation uses thresholds.decisionEscalationDays; freeze execution remains A3-only.
Latest Phase-11 conformance and P&L artifacts are within thresholds.evidenceSloMaxAgeDays at the Phase-12 baseline. Missing/stale evidence becomes a governed evidence-freshness breach.
Kill candidates use config-driven age/refresh/deadline rules; an overdue triggered asset without a non-INVEST portfolio decision is rejected. Current kill queue is empty.
